name: Galleria Bangalore Cube Open A 2025

venue.name: The Galleria Mall
venue.address: The Galleria Mall, Police Station, SH 9, opposite Yelahanka, Ambedkar Colony, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064

information: Please note that this is a twin competition so you can compete in either Galleria Cube Open A or Galleria Cube Open B. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except the New comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they have to Judge (or) Scramble in which they are participating. All the staff/volunteering assignments will be decided by the organising team and participants will be informed of the same 2 days prior to the event, we will ensure that your volunteering does not affect your events. Please check out all the tabs for additional important information.
